pages.title: Christmas Party
pages.concept: A single-sided alpine après-ski Christmas party invitation with editable event details, centred around a snowy mountain lodge at blue hour and a festive striped ski sign pointing guests towards the celebration.
pages.artwork_description: A wide snowy alpine village scene at dusk. A simplified spruce-green mountain lodge spans the lower third, with a snow-capped roof, warmly glowing golden windows and small spruce trees at either side. Above, an airy cobalt sky holds a bold retro display headline reading “CHRISTMAS PARTY”. A tomato-red and warm-cream striped ski sign at one side points inward towards the lodge and reads “APRÈS SKI”. Beneath the lodge, a calm warm-cream panel provides a crisp, neatly centred editable hierarchy: “JOIN US FOR”, “[HOST / VENUE]”, “SATURDAY 14 DECEMBER · 7 PM”, “[ADDRESS]”, and “RSVP: [CONTACT]”. Small snowflakes, stars and painted snowdrifts decorate only the edges.
pages.generation_prompt: Single-sided landscape Christmas party invitation. Exact headline text: “CHRISTMAS PARTY”. Snowy alpine village at blue hour with a wide mountain lodge silhouette across the lower third, snow-capped roof, glowing warm windows, small flanking spruce trees and snowdrifts. Add one tomato-red and cream striped ski sign pointing inward, exact sign text: “APRÈS SKI”. Place a large uncluttered warm-cream event-details panel beneath the lodge with these exact editable lines: “JOIN US FOR”, “[HOST / VENUE]”, “SATURDAY 14 DECEMBER · 7 PM”, “[ADDRESS]”, “RSVP: [CONTACT]”. Add sparse edge-only snowflakes and tiny stars; protect all wording areas.
pages.production_notes: Single designed invitation page; supply the printing guide as a separate non-artwork deliverable. Verify all text exactly, especially the accented “APRÈS”. Keep bracketed fields editable in the final template and replace sample date/details only if a non-editable preview version is needed. Ensure the cream details panel remains clear of dry-brush texture and maintains strong contrast. Check that the ski-sign lettering is readable at home-print size, the full-bleed artwork has adequate printer-tolerance trimming allowance, and all essential words remain inside the trim-safe perimeter.
